nodes.label: CAP-1-1 1.1 User Inventory

metadata.title: 1.1 User Inventory
metadata.description: Regular and privileged users are identified and integrated into an inventory. System owners have control of all authorized users. Users not on the authorized user list will be denied access by policy.

nodes.label: CAP-1-2 1.2 Conditional User Access

metadata.title: 1.2 Conditional User Access
metadata.description: Creates a dynamic level of access for users through phased maturity. Dynamic user, device, and NPE access through risk profiles. Unknown or high-risk users are denied access with greater accuracy.

nodes.label: CAP-1-3 1.3 Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

metadata.title: 1.3 Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
metadata.description: Centralize MFA and identity provider capabilities. Users authenticate with at least two authentication factors. Users without multiple authentication forms are denied access.

nodes.label: CAP-1-4 1.4 Privileged Access Management (PAM)

metadata.title: 1.4 Privileged Access Management (PAM)
metadata.description: Remove permanent administrator privileges through PAM. Privileged identities are controlled, monitored, secured, and audited. Critical assets are secured through limits on admin access.

nodes.label: CAP-1-5 1.5 Identity Federation and User Credentialing

metadata.title: 1.5 Identity Federation and User Credentialing
metadata.description: Standardize ILM and integrate with organizational IDP/IDM. Credentials are issued, managed, and revoked across trust domains. Users lacking sufficient credentials are denied access.

nodes.label: CAP-1-6 1.6 Behavioral, Contextual ID, and Biometrics

metadata.title: 1.6 Behavioral, Contextual ID, and Biometrics
metadata.description: Enable UEBA with enterprise and organizational attributes. Behavioral, contextual, and biometric telemetry enhance access controls. Anomalous activity informs risk-based authentication.

nodes.label: CAP-1-7 1.7 Least Privileged Access

metadata.title: 1.7 Least Privileged Access
metadata.description: Enforce least privilege across enterprise access. Access is limited to minimum necessary privileges. Excessive privileges are removed or denied.

nodes.label: CAP-1-8 1.8 Continuous Authentication

metadata.title: 1.8 Continuous Authentication
metadata.description: Continuously evaluate authentication context during sessions. Sessions are continuously evaluated for risk. High-risk sessions are terminated or re-authenticated.

nodes.label: CAP-1-9 1.9 Integrated ICAM Platform

metadata.title: 1.9 Integrated ICAM Platform
metadata.description: Integrate ICAM capabilities across the enterprise. Enterprise ICAM provides unified identity services. Fragmented identity tooling is reduced.

nodes.label: CAP-2-1 2.1 Device Inventory

metadata.title: 2.1 Device Inventory
metadata.description: Maintain an inventory of authorized devices. Device inventory supports authorization decisions. Unknown devices are denied or quarantined.

nodes.label: CAP-2-2 2.2 Device Detection and Compliance

metadata.title: 2.2 Device Detection and Compliance
metadata.description: Detect devices and assess compliance posture. Non-compliant devices are identified. Non-compliant devices are blocked or remediated.

nodes.label: CAP-2-3 2.3 Device Authorization with Real Time Inspection

metadata.title: 2.3 Device Authorization with Real Time Inspection
metadata.description: Authorize devices using real-time inspection. Device health informs every access request. Unhealthy devices are denied access.

nodes.label: CAP-2-4 2.4 Remote Access

metadata.title: 2.4 Remote Access
metadata.description: Secure remote access to enterprise resources. Remote sessions meet zero trust requirements. Untrusted remote access is denied.

nodes.label: CAP-2-5 2.5 Partially and Fully Automated Asset, Vulnerability, and Patch Management

metadata.title: 2.5 Partially and Fully Automated Asset, Vulnerability, and Patch Management
metadata.description: Automate asset, vulnerability, and patch management. Assets are patched and vulnerabilities managed at scale. Unpatched assets are restricted.

nodes.label: CAP-2-6 2.6 Unified Endpoint Management and Mobile Device Management

metadata.title: 2.6 Unified Endpoint Management and Mobile Device Management
metadata.description: Manage endpoints and mobile devices consistently. Enterprise endpoint management is unified. Unmanaged endpoints are denied.

nodes.label: CAP-2-7 2.7 Endpoint and Extended Detection and Response

metadata.title: 2.7 Endpoint and Extended Detection and Response
metadata.description: Deploy EDR/XDR across endpoints. Endpoint threats are detected and responded to centrally. Compromised endpoints are isolated.

nodes.label: CAP-3-1 3.1 Application Inventory

metadata.title: 3.1 Application Inventory
metadata.description: Inventory applications and workloads. Applications are visible and authorized. Unknown applications are blocked or removed.

nodes.label: CAP-3-2 3.2 Secure Software Development and Integration

metadata.title: 3.2 Secure Software Development and Integration
metadata.description: Integrate secure development practices. Applications are developed and integrated securely. Insecure software is remediated before deployment.

nodes.label: CAP-3-3 3.3 Software Risk Management

metadata.title: 3.3 Software Risk Management
metadata.description: Manage software supply chain and component risk. Software risk is assessed and tracked. High-risk software is blocked or mitigated.

nodes.label: CAP-3-4 3.4 Resource Authorization and Integration

metadata.title: 3.4 Resource Authorization and Integration
metadata.description: Authorize application and workload resources. Resources are authorized before access is granted. Unauthorized resources are denied.

nodes.label: CAP-3-5 3.5 Continuous Monitoring and Ongoing Authorizations

metadata.title: 3.5 Continuous Monitoring and Ongoing Authorizations
metadata.description: Continuously monitor applications for authorization. Ongoing authorization replaces point-in-time approvals. Drift from authorized state triggers response.

nodes.label: CAP-4-1 4.1 Data Catalog Risk Alignment

metadata.title: 4.1 Data Catalog Risk Alignment
metadata.description: Align data catalogs with risk management. Data assets are cataloged with risk context. Uncataloged sensitive data is discovered and protected.

nodes.label: CAP-4-2 4.2 DoD Enterprise Data Governance

metadata.title: 4.2 DoD Enterprise Data Governance
metadata.description: Govern data across the enterprise. Enterprise data governance is established. Ungoverned data flows are restricted.

nodes.label: CAP-4-3 4.3 Data Labeling and Tagging

metadata.title: 4.3 Data Labeling and Tagging
metadata.description: Label and tag data for protection decisions. Data is labeled consistently. Unlabeled sensitive data is remediated.

nodes.label: CAP-4-4 4.4 Data Monitoring and Sensing

metadata.title: 4.4 Data Monitoring and Sensing
metadata.description: Monitor data access and movement. Data usage is visible in near real time. Anomalous data access triggers response.

nodes.label: CAP-4-5 4.5 Data Encryption and Rights Management

metadata.title: 4.5 Data Encryption and Rights Management
metadata.description: Encrypt data and enforce rights management. Sensitive data is encrypted and rights-managed. Unprotected sensitive data is blocked or encrypted.

nodes.label: CAP-4-6 4.6 Data Loss Prevention

metadata.title: 4.6 Data Loss Prevention
metadata.description: Prevent unauthorized data exfiltration. DLP controls are deployed enterprise-wide. Data exfiltration attempts are blocked.

nodes.label: CAP-4-7 4.7 Data Access Control

metadata.title: 4.7 Data Access Control
metadata.description: Control access to data based on policy. Data access follows least privilege. Unauthorized data access is denied.

nodes.label: CAP-5-1 5.1 Data Flow Mapping

metadata.title: 5.1 Data Flow Mapping
metadata.description: Map data flows across the environment. Data flows are documented and monitored. Unknown flows are restricted.

nodes.label: CAP-5-2 5.2 Software Defined Networking

metadata.title: 5.2 Software Defined Networking
metadata.description: Use SDN for dynamic network policy. Network policy is software defined. Static overly permissive paths are removed.

nodes.label: CAP-5-3 5.3 Macro Segmentation

metadata.title: 5.3 Macro Segmentation
metadata.description: Segment the network at macro boundaries. Macro segments limit lateral movement. Cross-segment access requires authorization.

nodes.label: CAP-5-4 5.4 Micro Segmentation

metadata.title: 5.4 Micro Segmentation
metadata.description: Apply fine-grained network segmentation. Micro segments enforce least privilege network access. Unnecessary east-west traffic is denied.

nodes.label: CAP-6-1 6.1 API Standardization

metadata.title: 6.1 API Standardization
metadata.description: Standardize APIs for security automation. Security tooling integrates through standard APIs. Non-standard integrations are reduced.

nodes.label: CAP-6-2 6.2 Critical Process Automation

metadata.title: 6.2 Critical Process Automation
metadata.description: Automate critical security processes. Key security processes are automated. Manual gaps in security response are reduced.

nodes.label: CAP-6-3 6.3 Machine Learning

metadata.title: 6.3 Machine Learning
metadata.description: Apply machine learning to security operations. ML augments detection and response. Anomalies are detected faster.

nodes.label: CAP-6-4 6.4 Artificial Intelligence

metadata.title: 6.4 Artificial Intelligence
metadata.description: Apply AI to security orchestration and response. AI-assisted response is integrated. Response latency is reduced.

nodes.label: CAP-6-5 6.5 Automated Decision Making

metadata.title: 6.5 Automated Decision Making
metadata.description: Automate policy-based security decisions. Decisions are automated within policy bounds. Manual policy enforcement gaps are reduced.

nodes.label: CAP-6-6 6.6 Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR)

metadata.title: 6.6 Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR)
metadata.description: Orchestrate automated security response. SOAR integrates security tooling. Incident response is coordinated automatically.

nodes.label: CAP-6-7 6.7 Security Operations Center (SOC) Optimization

metadata.title: 6.7 Security Operations Center (SOC) Optimization
metadata.description: Optimize SOC workflows for zero trust. SOC processes support zero trust operations. Operational blind spots are reduced.

nodes.label: CAP-7-1 7.1 Log All Traffic (Network, Data, Apps, User)

metadata.title: 7.1 Log All Traffic (Network, Data, Apps, User)
metadata.description: Log traffic across all zero trust pillars. Comprehensive logging is available for analysis. Unlogged critical traffic is remediated.

nodes.label: CAP-7-2 7.2 Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)

metadata.title: 7.2 Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)
metadata.description: Centralize security event management. Events are correlated in a SIEM. Uncorrelated critical events are escalated.

nodes.label: CAP-7-3 7.3 Common Security and Risk Analytics

metadata.title: 7.3 Common Security and Risk Analytics
metadata.description: Share analytics across the enterprise. Risk analytics are common and reusable. Siloed analytics are integrated.

nodes.label: CAP-7-4 7.4 User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA)

metadata.title: 7.4 User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA)
metadata.description: Analyze user and entity behavior. Behavioral analytics inform access decisions. Anomalous behavior triggers response.

nodes.label: CAP-7-5 7.5 Threat Intelligence Integration

metadata.title: 7.5 Threat Intelligence Integration
metadata.description: Integrate threat intelligence into analytics. Threat intelligence enriches detections. Known threats are blocked faster.

nodes.label: CAP-7-6 7.6 Automated Dynamic Policies

metadata.title: 7.6 Automated Dynamic Policies
metadata.description: Dynamically update policies from analytics. Policies adapt based on analytics. Stale policies are automatically updated.

nodes.label: TENET-2 Presume Breach

nodes.label: TENET-3 Never Trust, Always Verify

nodes.label: TENET-4 Scrutinize Explicitly
